name: heuristic-evaluation
description: Evaluate a UI against Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics (or alternate heuristic sets: Norman, Shneiderman, mobile, accessibility, conversational). Per finding: location, heuristic violated, Nielsen severity (0-4: cosmetic → catastrophic), evidence, impact, and concrete recommendation. Supports single-evaluator autonomous mode and multi-evaluator aggregation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
